rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 1 of 8 on double 60 m ropes, from the double-ring anchor at the top of pitch 10 to the top of pitch 9.
Rappel 2 of 8 on double 60 m ropes, from the double-ring anchor at the top of pitch 9 to the top of pitch 8.
Rappel 3 of 8 on double 60 m ropes, from the double-ring anchor at the top of pitch 8 to the top of pitch 7.
Rappel 4 of 8 on double 60 m ropes, from the double-ring anchor at the top of pitch 7 to the top of pitch 6.
Rappel 5 of 8 on double 60 m ropes, from the double-ring anchor at the top of pitch 6 to the top of pitch 5.
Rappel 6 of 8 on double 60 m ropes, from the double-ring anchor at the top of pitch 5 to the top of pitch 4.
Rappel 7 of 8 on double 60 m ropes, from the double-ring anchor at the top of pitch 4 to the top of pitch 3.

Rappel 8 of 8, from the anchor at the top of pitch 3 (the first main-wall pitch) to the foot of the main face. The two approach pitches below are usually downclimbed or scrambled rather than rappelled.
